subject: Post-call recap + propose demo windows; looping security & procurement
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@finlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + propose demo windows; looping security & procurement

Hi Samantha — great conversation earlier, thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Quick summary: You’re evaluating an inference platform to reduce per-token costs on nightly batch jobs and standardize low-latency features for your customer-facing product. Primary constraints: SSO + SAML, data residency for EU customers (future), and SOC 2 evidence for procurement.
- To cover that, we recommend a 60–75 minute technical deep dive (demo + infra Q&A) with your platform/security/procurement folks. Marissa will cover the commercial path; Kimberly will be the security lead from our side.

Proposed demo windows (all PT; I can send invites as soon as you pick one):
  1) Tue Oct 12 — 10:00–11:15 PT
  2) Wed Oct 13 — 13:00–14:15 PT
  3) Thu Oct 14 — 09:00–10:15 PT

Please let me know which option works and which of these people from your side should join (platform engineer, CISO or security manager, procurement contact). If none of those times work, propose 2 alternatives and we’ll adapt.

Attaching a short post-call notes PDF and a link to a HubSpot record + a SOC2 summary we can share ahead of the call.

Attachments: postcall-notes.pdf

Thanks — looking forward to locking a time.

— Diego
Diego Fernandez | Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
D: +1 415-555-0119 | diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com

Thanks Diego — appreciate the clear recap. 

Quick answers:
- Our platform engineering lead (Raj Patel) and procurement (Alyssa Moore) should join. Alyssa is out today but I looped Raj above.
- Of the slots you proposed, Wed Oct 13 13:00 PT works best for Raj. If you can’t do that, Thu Oct 14 09:00 PT is our second choice.

Couple of asks ahead of the call:
1) Can you surface SOC2 scope and where customer data is stored during inference?
2) We also have a short RFI — I’ve attached it to this reply (Finlytics_RFI.xlsx) so you can pre-fill any items you know.

Forwarding Alyssa and Raj separately once I confirm their availability.

Thanks,
Samantha

Perfect — Wed Oct 13 13:00 PT is locked on our side. I’ll send the calendar invite in a minute (expect a 75-minute invite).

Kimberly — looping you in to cover security; we’ll plan to walk through: 
- SOC2 artifacts scope and redaction options (I’ve attached the short SOC2 summary for preliminary review),
- SSO/SAML setup and our SAML metadata flow,
- Data handling (where ephemeral cache and persistent logs live),
- Any tenant isolation questions Raj/procurement surface.

Marissa — I’ve included you to surface the commercial timeline / procurement checklist during the meeting so Alyssa understands contracting steps.

Links and prep: 
- HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/finlytics
- Shared prep folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3CREDWOOD
- SOC2 summary (attachment): redwood-soc2-summary.pdf

If Raj/Alyssa want us to pre-fill the RFI, we can take the first pass and return it before the meeting.

On Wed we’ll do: 20 min demo (cost/latency/fallover), 25 min infra & SSO deep dive with Kimberly, 15 min procurement Q&A, 15 min open items + next steps.

Thanks — Diego
